title: U.S. Eyes Iran as Possible Culprit in Dozens of New Cyberattacks Against Ships
summary: As many as 50 ships carrying oil and other explosive substances are believed to have been attacked, U.S. officials said.

title: Quebecor (QBCRF) CEO ‘Encouraged’ by Telus (TU) Canada Merger Talks
summary: Quebecor Inc. said it was encouraged by talks with Telus Corp. executives on Monday, one week after publicly announcing a proposed tie-up of the two Canadian telecom firms.
